name: nba-edge-desktop
description: Self-contained NBA ML sports betting desktop app with automatic file sync
author: YCSLINT

scripts.build:win:signed: node scripts/ensure-win-certificate.mjs && cross-env SIGN_WINDOWS=true electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.build:portable: npm run setup:python && cross-env SIGN_WINDOWS=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.json
scripts.build:portable:signed: npm run setup:python && node scripts/ensure-win-certificate.mjs && cross-env SIGN_WINDOWS=true electron-builder --config electron-builder.portable.config.cjs
